visual_logic.character_specs: Paleontologist 4: White male, blonde hair, blue field shirt.
visual_logic.action: He is holding a large, robust teardrop-shaped tooth in his palm, brushing away sand from the vertical ridges on its surface.
visual_logic.morphology_priority: THE RIDGED LEAF: The tooth is thick and leaf-shaped with very distinct vertical ridges (pleats) running down the face. The top edge is jagged. It looks significantly larger and more 'industrial' than the Stegosaurus spade.
visual_logic.color: Warm amber-brown or rust-orange, looking like it was found in iron-rich soil.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; Emphasize the vertical 'pleats' on the tooth surface as this is the primary way players will identify it.
